Pending demonstration details and programmed questions identify owners, interim instructions and pre-distribution gates; their pending status is not itself a defect.
The SUBMIT instruction and submission-failure recovery are present and coherent. No named customer/project or specific deployment count appears in the supplied sections.
Section 05 was not supplied and is not scored. Preservation of its live roster and event times, and the destinations of operational references, cannot be verified from this excerpt.
